run_openevolve: run the OpenEvolve evolution process on an initial program with a config and evaluation file
run_with_checkpoints: run the OpenEvolve evolution process resuming from a saved checkpoint path
run_with_target_score: run the OpenEvolve evolution process until a target score is reached
save_checkpoint: save a checkpoint of the current evolution state at a given iteration number
load_checkpoint: load a previous checkpoint to resume the evolution process from a saved state
